The green creature only leaves the cave in search of food.Meanwhile, the residents of Whosiów are eagerly awaiting a special time of the year, Christmas.Wanting to keep the peace, the Grinch plans to spoil the grand celebrations and kidnap Santa Claus.At the same time, Cindy-Lou and her friends intend to capture a Lappish benefactor to thank him for helping the girl's busy mother.Two opposing intentions will face an inevitable confrontation.Another film adaptation of the adventures of a character created by a children's book writer, Dr.Seuss.Previously, Jim Carrey played the green creature in the 2000 film "The Grinch: No Christmas."In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others:Jarosław Boberek, Lila Wassermann, Ewa Prus and Karol Kwiatkowski.The carol was performed by Katarzyna Owczarz, Małgorzata Szymańska, Adam Krylik and Krzysztof Pietrzak.

programme.title: Little women
programme.desc: The times of the Civil War.In the absence of their father, who is serving in the military away from the family, the four March sisters from Orchard House are cared for by their mother alone.Marmee wants them to find their own path and helps them enter adulthood.Each of them has a different personality.The oldest Meg dreams of becoming an actress.Family-oriented and warm, Beth has a talent for playing the piano.Jo, an aspiring writer, pursues her goal with her characteristic energy and tenacity.Amy, a bit smart, wants to become a painter.Despite their own problems, the girls are not indifferent to other people's suffering.Young women will get to know the taste of first loves and disappointments.Fate subjects them to tests, after which their lives will never be the same again.

programme.title: The Fountain
programme.desc: Three stories about man's pursuit of immortality.16th century.In the forests of South America, Spanish conquistador Tomas Creo (Hugh Jackman), head over heels in love with Queen Isabella I of Castile (Rachel Weisz), is looking for the legendary tree of life for her.The ruler wants to use them to finally solve the problem of the power struggle with a certain high-ranking cardinal.In the 20th century, scientist Tom Creo (Hugh Jackman) tries to find a cure that will save his seriously ill wife Izzi (Rachel Weisz).A man cannot come to terms with the fact that his beloved is dying.He decides to devote himself to finding a way to overcome death.Six centuries later, astronaut Tommy (Hugh Jackman) travels through space in a glass ball.He wants to reach the golden nebula, hoping to bring Izzi back to life.A science-fiction drama by Darren Aronofsky, author of "Requiem for a Dream", "Black Swan" and "The Wrestler".

programme.title: Queer
programme.desc: Year 1950, Mexico.William Lee (Daniel Craig), a middle-aged American, spends his days almost alone.He contacts several people from a small American community of students and bar owners.The arrival of another student, Eugene Allerton (Drew Starkey), in town makes him realize for the first time that an intimate bond is possible.The men first become friends, then their relationship turns into a romance.As a couple, they go to South America in search of a drug that supposedly gives the power of telepathy.

programme.title: Babygirl
programme.desc: Romy (Nicole Kidman) leads a stable and prosperous life.She manages a modern, dynamically developing company, lives in a comfortable house with her devoted husband Jacob (Antonio Banderas) and two teenage daughters.Her everyday life changes when a young intern, Samuel (Harris Dickinson), appears.Despite the age difference, Romy and Samuel begin a fiery romance.The woman begins to rediscover herself, although this decision may mean the loss of both her professional position and her family.She is faced with the decision of whether to follow her own desires, risking everything she has achieved so far.

programme.title: Zombieland
programme.desc: A mysterious plague turns most people into bloodthirsty zombies.Only a few manage to avoid infection.This lucky group includes a clumsy and clumsy Columbus student.The boy is afraid of almost everything.The prospect of living in a world overrun by beasts terrifies him.Meanwhile, his friend, the brave Tallahassee, is excited about the whole situation.He is a tough guy who intends to single-handedly kill every monster that stands in his way.The men must fight the monsters together.They can count on the help of the sisters - Wichita and Little Rock.The girls try to alleviate the tense atmosphere between the men.For them, enduring each other's company is as difficult as getting rid of zombies.

programme.title: Assassin's Creed
programme.desc: Recidivist Callum Lynch sentenced to death is not executed.After a fake execution, he ends up in a secret laboratory.There he meets Rikkin and his daughter Sofia.Scientists have a mysterious device that allows them to access the records of ancestors' actions stored in their genes.The criminal is to connect with the consciousness of Aguilar from Spain, who lived during the Great Inquisition and obtained the Apple of Eden, which provides control over emotions.By using this item, you can supposedly eliminate aggression in people.The daredevil travels to the Middle Ages.He discovers that he is a descendant of a member of the Assassin secret society.Over time, he learns what a big mistake he made when he trusted Sofia and her father.

programme.title: BlacKkKlansman
programme.desc: Early 1970s, Colorado Springs, Colorado.Ron Stallworth (John David Washington) becomes the first black police officer in the department.After encountering manifestations of racism, he asks to be transferred to undercover work.He decides to infiltrate the Ku Klux Klan, but for this he will need the help of an older, white colleague - Flip Zimmerman (Adam Driver).Ron calls representatives of a racist militia on the phone, and Flip meets with them directly.The police obtain information about the Klan's planned attack.Ron contacts David Duke (Topher Grace), the Grand Wizard of the Ku Klux Klan, by phone.Soon, Flip is accepted into the organization.Spike Lee's film won an Oscar for best adapted screenplay in 2019.Starring: versatile supporting actor Adam Driver ("What's Up, Davis?", "Silence") and former American football player John David Washington, Denzel Washington's son, nominated for a Golden Globe for this role.

credits.actor: Master Patrolman Andy Landers - Frederick Weller

programme.title: Veep 4
programme.desc: The story of Vice President Selina Meyer (Julia Louis-Dreyfus) continues, as she and her colleagues want to achieve something significant in politics.The woman avoids deals, scandals and corruption.She is assisted in her daily work by Amy, her office manager (Anna Chlumsky), spokesman Mike McLintock (Matt Walsh), general counsel Gary (Tony Hale) and secretary Sue (Sufe Bradshaw).The entire team must contend with the ambitious Dan Egan (Reid Scott) and the confident White House employee Jonah Ryan (Timothy Simons).

programme.title: Wunderschöner
programme.desc: 50-year-old Nadine (Anneke Kim Sarnau) does everything to look young.When she discovers that her husband (Godehard Giese) is cheating on her, she falls into depression.The couple's daughter Lilly (Emilia Packard) is interested in the classes lectured by feminist Vicky (Nora Tschirner).Enno, the narrator's boyfriend, participates in the project of her new colleague Trevor (Malick Bauer).He doesn't know that his beloved will soon lose her head for him.Julie (Emilia Schüle), a new TV production manager, suffers from loneliness.Her difficult relationship with her co-worker increases her doubts about herself.Sonja (Karoline Herfurth) and Milan (Friedrich Mücke) go to family therapy.When it comes to light that the man has a new partner, the woman starts dating.

programme.title: The Book of Life
programme.desc: Two powerful magicians bet whether people are pure in heart.La Muerte is the ruler of the World of the Remembered.The dead stay there, remaining in the hearts of their loved ones.Xibalba rules the Land of the Forgotten - a sad place for souls that no one remembers.The magicians are tested by: fashion matador Manolo, who dreams of being a musician, and Joaquin - an athlete and the pride of the city.The boys compete for the affections of Maria, the daughter of the local mayor.However, the beautiful bride is resistant to their advances.Manolo and Joaquin will go on a wonderful journey, during which they will visit extraordinary lands, meet colorful characters and discover the truth about themselves.The project by Guillermo del Toro and Jorge R. Gutierrez was nominated for a Golden Globe in the category of best animated film.

programme.title: Neuilly-Poissy
programme.desc: Daniel (Max Boublil) is a successful entrepreneur.He successfully combines running a business with a successful family life.However, when financial irregularities are discovered in his company, he is forced to exchange a luxurious apartment in the city of Neuilly for a cell in the prison in Poissy.From one day to the next, he finds himself in a world whose rules he does not understand.Moreover, he is a Jew and now he will be hanging out with Muslims.However, thanks to his sense of humor and the ability to cope with difficult situations, Daniel tries to adapt to the new reality.

programme.title: Goodbye, Christopher Robin
programme.desc: End of World War I.A.A.Milne (Domhnall Gleeson) moves to the countryside with his family and, finding inspiration in the toys of his son Christopher Robin (Will Tilston), creates a story about the adventures of Winnie the Pooh, who will soon become a children's favorite.However, the quickly achieved international success is not only about profits.The price of A.A.'s fameMilne will suffer not only himself, but also his wife Daphne (Margot Robbie), their son and his caregiver Olive (Kelly Macdonald).The moving film with biographical elements received a BIFA nomination for best supporting actress - Kelly Macdonald.The music composed by Carter Burwell was appreciated by the World Academy of Film Music.

credits.actor: Christopher Robin Aged 6 Months - Stanley Hamlin

programme.title: Beautiful
programme.desc: The intertwined adventures of several women who are looking for happiness and fulfillment at different stages of life.Magda (Marta Nieradkiewicz) tries to reconcile raising children and running a home with her professional ambitions.Distrustful Basia (Marta Ścisłowicz) avoids love, even though she wants it very much.Krysia (Hanna Śleszyńska), a married woman for 30 years, tries to arouse a bit of enthusiasm in the bored and apathetic Władek (Olaf Lubaszenko).Businesswoman Agata (Katarzyna Herman) is successful at work, but cannot find a common language with her daughter.Julia (Kamila Urzędowska) tries to make it in an industry that values ​​only youth and beauty.She discovers how much she will have to sacrifice.Polish remake of the German comedy "Wunderschön" from 2022.

programme.title: Rooster
programme.desc: Greg Russo (Steve Carell) has written a best-selling series of books, and readers identify him with his literary hero nicknamed Rooster.A famous writer comes to the university campus to support his daughter (Charly Clive) who is going through a marital crisis in a difficult moment.Her partner has just left her for a student, which everyone knows perfectly well.The situation is further complicated by scandals involving a woman who are the subject of gossip in the academic community.The father declares help, but his presence quickly reveals old conflicts and uncomfortable topics, instead of bringing the expected solution.

programme.title: Euphoria
programme.desc: The further fate of a group of friends who left school behind and entered adulthood.The action moves forward several years.Rue (Zendaya Coleman) is no longer a lost teenager, but a person involved in the criminal world.He goes to interrogation in connection with smuggling drugs from Mexico.Cassie (Sydney Sweeney) and Maddy's (Alexa Demie) relationship has improved, but old wounds haven't healed at all.The first woman's relationship with Nate (Jacob Elordi) develops, but not towards a happy ending.The remaining characters confront their own choices, addiction and violence.They are looking for redemption and answers to the question about their place in the world.

programme.title: Peacemaker 2

programme.title: Half Man
programme.desc: 1980s. The life of bullied teenage Niall (Mitchell Robertson) turns upside down when the son of his mother's partner, the fierce and unpredictable Ruben (Stuart Campbell), comes to live with them for a while.Even though they are not related by blood, over time they both become inseparable.However, subsequent events make them move away from each other.Three decades later, Ruben (Richard Gadd) shows up uninvited at Niall's (Jamie Bell) wedding.It soon becomes clear why he reconnected with his long-lost brother.A suggestive story about the fragility of male relationships, brotherhood, betrayal, loyalty and violence.

programme.desc: The virus spreading throughout Great Britain, which triggered murderous instincts in people, devastated the entire country.28 weeks later, the authorities decide to repopulate the deserted areas.Settlers are brought to a closely guarded part of London.Among them are Don Harris (Robert Carlyle) and his teenage children, Andy (Mackintosh Muggleton) and Tammy (Imogen Poots).The siblings sneak out at night to a destroyed part of the city.They find their mother (Catherine McCormack) there and decide to bring her to the base.

programme.title: The Martian
programme.desc: A mission to the Red Planet is interrupted by a sandstorm.A team of astronauts evacuates to Earth, leaving one of the expedition members, Mark Watney (Matt Damon), on the surface of Mars, believing he is dead.After some time, the seriously injured astronaut regains consciousness.He realizes that his air and food supplies will soon be exhausted.He also cannot count on a rescue mission because he was presumed dead.Despite this, he tries to survive in difficult conditions and notify the inhabitants of Earth that he is alive and waiting for help.Ridley Scott's film is nominated for an Oscar in seven categories, including:as the best film and for the leading role of Matt Damon.Director Ridley Scott, the creator of such cult sci-fi films as "Blade Runner" and the Alien series, was a candidate for the Academy Award four times.

programme.title: Gaga Chromatica Ball
programme.desc: The performance of the famous singer Lady Gaga recorded in 2022 at Dodger Stadium in Los Angeles.The concert, which was part of The Chromatica Ball's tour promoting its sixth album, took place in front of an audience of 52,000.The singer performed, among others:their greatest hits, such as "Stupid Love", "Bad Romance", "Just Dance", "Poker Face", "Shallow", and "Rain On Me".The whole is complemented by songs played on the piano, amazing choreography, spectacular pyrotechnics and the artist's spectacular stylings.

programme.desc: 1970s.Teenage Dražen Petrovic (Tonko Stosic) living in Šibenik discovers, thanks to his older brother, Aleksander (Lovre Tanfara), that he has a talent for playing basketball.At first, he trained only with him or alone - in the evenings in the gym.When his abilities are noticed at school, he joins the local team, Šibenka, where he is successful.During this time, he falls in love with Renata (Romina Tonkovic).Over time, a talented young man (Domagoj Nizic) goes to a club in Zagreb and then abroad, among others.to Real Madrid, and finally received an offer to play with the New York Brooklyn Nets team, part of the NBA league.Unfortunately, Dražen's passion for basketball also becomes his curse, and success is associated with problems in his personal life, also in his relationship with Renata.A biographical story about the outstanding Croatian athlete, called the Mozart of basketball, who was the first European to play in the NBA.

programme.desc: The year 2050. Mickey Barnes (Robert Pattinson) takes out a loan on usurious terms.Wanting to escape from an aggressive debt collector, together with his friend Timo (Steven Yeun), he joins the crew of a spaceship that is to colonize the ice planet Niflheim.However, when the second of them becomes a shuttle pilot, Mickey - not entirely consciously - becomes the person assigned to the most dangerous tasks.When he dies, in a process called reprinting, a clone of himself is created, which retains his memories.The situation of the version of man number 17 becomes even more complicated when, contrary to expectations, he is not killed during one of the missions, and when he returns to the ship, he finds Mickey 18 there. In these circumstances, the commander of the expedition, Hieronymous Marshall (Mark Ruffalo), decides to eliminate both of them.A surprising, fast-paced and humorous picture by the Oscar-winning writer and director of "Parasite", Bong Joon Ho.The production is an adaptation of the novel by Edward Ashton.

programme.desc: In the Macedonian village of Yuruk, the inhabitants live in accordance with tradition.Young people quickly start families and go on their own.15-year-old Ahmet (Arif Jakup) usually looks after sheep and takes care of his younger brother, but he loves electronic music and would like to become a DJ.To the dismay of his father and the conservative community, he equips his tractor with a sound system.His path crosses with a fellow dancer, Aya, who also dreams of a different life.The girl will soon get married according to her parents' decision.Together they decide to organize a party - as a rebellious act of freedom and self-expression.The feature debut of a creator from North Macedonia, who turned out to be one of the winners of Sundance in 2025.It's a touching story about growing up in a place where techno and tradition do not go hand in hand.

programme.desc: Jane Hayes (Keri Russell) is thirty years old, single and loves Jane Austen's novels.In men, she looks for similarities to Mr. Darcy, the hero of "Pride and Prejudice", played by Colin Firth years ago.One day, the woman decides to spend all her savings to go to Great Britain, following in the footsteps of her beloved writer.There he goes to a residence for Jane Austen enthusiasts.The woman doesn't think it will be the most beautiful trip of her life.A warm comedy intended for fans of Jane Austen's works.The film, nominated for an award at the Sundance Film Festival, was directed by Jerushy Hess.The screenplay was based on the novel of the same title by Shannon Hale.The main character was played by Golden Globe winner Keri Russell (series "Felicity", "The Magic of Ordinary Days").

programme.title: Uncharted
programme.desc: New York.Young Nathan Drake (Tom Holland), a descendant of the explorer Francis Drake, works as a bartender in an upscale establishment where he does not hesitate to rob his wealthy customers from time to time.At the same time, the boy believes that he knows where the legendary Eldorado is.One day, he is visited at a bar by experienced treasure hunter Victor "Sully" Sullivan (Mark Wahlberg).The man invites the boy to participate in an expedition to find the treasure of the Portuguese sailor Ferdinand Magellan, who was lost 500 years ago.Together they set off on a crazy and adventurous journey.It soon turns out that they have to hurry, because the ruthless Santiago Moncada (Antonio Banderas) and the mercenary Jo Braddock (Tati Gabrielle) are also looking for the valuables.In addition, the travelers try to find Nathan's missing brother, and because it is sometimes difficult for them to communicate, they learn to cooperate.A spectacular adaptation of a popular video game.

programme.title: King Charles III
programme.desc: After the death of Elizabeth II, her son Charles (Tim Pigott-Smith) takes over power in Great Britain.During his first meeting with Prime Minister Tristan Evans (Adam James), he learns about the draft law regulating the rights of the press, which has already been adopted by both the House of Commons and the House of Lords and is only awaiting the king's consent.Charles refuses to sign it, fearing that the new law will limit press freedom and allow the government to use censorship.Then, due to the prime minister's threat to introduce the law without royal consent, he dissolves parliament.Soon a wave of protests begins to sweep across the country, with the most violent taking place in London.The difficult situation at Buckingham Palace is not improved by a sex scandal involving the ruler's younger son, Prince Henry (Richard Goulding), related to the publication of compromising photos of him with his lover, Jessica (Tamara Lawrance).Charles's older son, William (Oliver Chris), and his wife Catherine (Charlotte Riley) also do not support the king.The young man accuses his father of causing the crisis and demands that he abdicate.A film version of Mike Bartlett's play of the same title.The author is also the author of the script for this production.

programme.desc: Combat medics risk it all to save soldiers under fire. We join their training to see what it takes to save lives in the field.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Basic Training"
programme.desc: Basic training transforms civilians into soldiers, sailors, and airmen through intense physical and psychological tests.

programme.title: War Machines S1 - "Triumphant On Land"
programme.desc: Highlighting some of the most influential movers ever to take to the battlefield including some of the most infamous tanks.

programme.title: War Machines S1 - "Ruling The Waves"
programme.desc: From the most deadly submarines ever seen to the infamous destroyers of the Second World War, this episode is the story of what it takes to rule the waves.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Coup In Crimea"
programme.desc: The Crimea Annexation in February 2014 was the biggest and most blatant land grab in Europe since WWII and shook the very foundations upon which peace in the region had been based ever since. How did Russia execute the annexation?

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Yemen Britain & The Saudis"
programme.desc: In March 2019 news reports appeared in the British press of UK’s troops being killed in Yemen, no one knew why they are there in the first place. Britain was not fighting a war in Yemen. This episode investigates the truth behind the casualties.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Somalia Pirates & Black Hawkdown"
programme.desc: On the 3 October 1993, an elite battle unit of the US army began a fairly straight-forward mission in Somalia’s capital Mogadishu. Within minutes of reaching their destination, the situation descended into chaos and the mission turned into a battle.

programme.title: How Things Work S1 - "Paintball Guns, Ice Machines and Pool Tables"
programme.sub-title: Paintball Guns, Ice Machines and Pool Tables
programme.desc: Paintball gun, floor scrubber, ice machine, pool table, shopping trolley, gas boiler... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

programme.title: How Things Work S1 - "Hiking Boots, Pianos and Vending Machines"
programme.sub-title: Hiking Boots, Pianos and Vending Machines
programme.desc: Car winch, hiking boot, coffee machine, piano, vending machine, abseil catch... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

programme.title: The Aviators S1 - "AirVenture"
programme.desc: America’s largest aviation celebration.

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "Machu Picchu"
programme.desc: Stripping away the granite, CGI reveals the quake-proof walls and hidden canals that allowed Machu Picchu to survive at 11,000 feet.

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "Los Angeles"
programme.desc: Stripping Los Angeles to its core, CGI reveals the hidden steel and fault lines that help this earthquake-prone city survive "the Big One."

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "New Orleans"
programme.desc: CGI peels back the Superdome and the city’s silt to reveal the massive pumps and barriers keeping New Orleans from sinking.

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "New York"
programme.desc: Dissecting New York's stone and steel, CGI reveals the inflatable subway plugs and bedrock foundations shielding the city from Atlantic superstorms.

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "Bridges: City Icons"

While over 10 million Koreans travel abroad each year, the '2 Days and 1 Night' casts travel around Korea - to the mountains, farms, fishing villages, islands - where you can meet the welcoming smiles of our neighbors and the beautiful nature that cleanse our eyes.

programme.title: My Neighbor, Charles
programme.desc: Foreigners who have left their familiar worlds behind and come to the unfamiliar land of Korea! A vivid, real-life adaptation story of foreigners trying to settle into Korean society for various reasons. This reality program warmly portrays their concerns about jobs, marriage, and parenting while living in Korea.

programme.title: Recipe For Love
programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.title: Noona, You Are A Woman To Me
programme.desc: Age is just a number-attraction is pure instinct. Charismatic “Noonas” (older women) who have long put love on hold to pursue their careers meet younger men who fearlessly follow their hearts, sparking emotionally driven romances. Breaking through the real-world barriers of age differences, this bold and candid reality series follows older-woman–younger-man couples as they explore love with honesty and courage. As their relationships unfold, long-dormant romantic instincts are awakened in this refreshingly daring dating reality show.

Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.title: Bablu Dablu-Spring Into Action
programme.desc: The forest animals love trees, flowers and spring. So it's up to the bear brothers to stop Logger Vick from chopping down every tree.

programme.title: Bablu Dablu
programme.desc: This series follows Lakha, Bablu and Dablu on brand-new wildadventures. Pine Tree Mountain has become a preserve that drawsvisitors from all around to see its natural beauty and wildlife.

programme.title: Fury Spinner
programme.desc: After decades of development, Fury Spinner duel has become one of the most popular sports in the world. At this time, the "Ultimate Feast" Invitational Tournament of Fury Spinner began. The protagonist Meteo is invited to the mysterious island together with other top players in the world to embark on a survival adventure. During the adventure, Meteo not only relied on his determination to protect the weak and gained recognition to unlock the power of the sacred beast, but also got acquainted with the hidden master Kim who came here to find his brother and Joll who wanted to prove as the “perfect warrior” to his father. However, this "Ultimate Feast" tournament is just a conspiracy of the organizer Kenji! He wants to use the players to awaken the evil forces in the island to destroy the world! Meteo and friends stepped forward and tried their best to defeat Kenji.

programme.title: Bablu Dablu Shrunk
programme.desc: This series follows Lakha, Bablu and Dablu on brand-new wild adventures. Pine Tree Mountain has become a preserve that draws visitors from all around to see its natural beauty and wildlife. This wildlife now includes some new but familiar residents: Hugo and friends from the hit movie, The Big Top Secret!

programme.title: Cindrella
programme.desc: Young Cinderella, struggling with abuse from her stepmother and stepsisters, receives help from her fairy godmother and animal friends while finding adventure and romance with a dashing man who hides the fact that he is a prince.

programme.title: Bablu Dablu Monster Paln
programme.desc: The crazy scientist, Doctor Rex Vector, and his hamster assistant, Mister Pete, return to Pine Tree Mountain with Vector's new, evil invention: a robo-monster complete with animal abilities. But first, Vector needs to collect these skills. He comes up with a power absorbing gadget, which he often disguises, in order to trap and steal abilities from the innocent animals. Vick, Briar and Bramble, along with other animal friends, must stand up against this “monster plan” of Vector's. It's going to be a fierce fight between wild animals and poaching villains.

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon
programme.desc: Yala National Park is an avian Eden, home to 215 species of bird. This paradise offers many possibilities for parents who can weather the ever-changing climate. programme.title: America's Wild Border: Northern Exposure
programme.desc: Trail Atlantic puffins, Prairie rattlesnakes, Alaskan caribou and other animals as they travel across the international boundary between the U.S. and Canada. See how they can move from safety to target by crossing a line they had no say in creating.

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon
programme.desc: The shadowy forests of Yala National Park are the perfect hideout for secretive leopards. It’s time for one young female, Asha, to strike out alone. Join her as she fights for her own territory, finds a mate, and becomes a mother.

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon
programme.desc: Every year, the biggest elephant congregation in Asia occurs in Minneriya National Park. Here in this sacred place, baby Loka is born. Watch as he learns to suckle, swim and handle his trunk among the mêlée of giants that make up his family.

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon
programme.desc: Sri Lanka’s lowlands are dotted with thousands of seemingly peaceful lakes, but don’t be fooled, this is the realm of the mugger crocodile. Muggers are hunters from day one. Watch as these supreme predators compete with each other in the fierce heat.

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon
programme.desc: A manmade lake in Minneriya National Park supports the largest concentration of elephants in Asia. Follow a young male who has reached a turning point toward adulthood. In the rainforest, jungles teem with a variety of bizarre species of insects.

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon
programme.desc: Monsoon storms sweep over the tropical island of Sri Lanka, and water carried in with swirling mists hits the mountainous heartland, beginning a journey through the many changing faces of the island’s forests.

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon
programme.desc: Yala National Park is an avian Eden, home to 215 species of bird. This paradise offers many possibilities for parents who can weather the ever-changing climate. Every species must either raise their offspring here or find a new home before the dry season ends and the monsoon storms begin.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas
programme.desc: Meet alphas who get by with a little help from their friends. Discover the inescapable gang mentality of mating male dolphins, ponder ant colonies’ unique scents, find out why female geladas always get the last word, and see wolves hunt family-style.

credits.director: Karen McCairley: Series Producer, Karen McCairley and Elizabeth Trojian: Directors

programme.title: Planet Weird
programme.desc: Discover how weirdness is baked into some animals’ DNA from birth. Check out the bowerbird’s funky mate-attracting dance moves, the Christmas Island crab’s traffic-dodging prowess, and the sockeye salmon’s incredible uphill swimming skills.

credits.director: Craig Meade: Producer, Ross Noble: Narrator

programme.title: Planet Weird
programme.desc: Look at the supercharged abilities that give some animals an edge in life. Discover fireflies’ flirty flashes, the tarsier’s incredible night vision, the mantis shrimp’s knockout punch, and the saltwater croc’s prey-detecting pressure sensors.

credits.director: Craig Meade: Producer, Ross Noble: Narrator

programme.title: Wild Philippines
programme.desc: Bask in the interconnected lives of wildlife shaped by volcanoes, forests, and seas. Take flight with rare Philippine eagles as they raise their young in an ancient tree, then dive into a river to catch a glimpse of the world’s rarest crocodile.

credits.director: JOHANNES BERGER and STEPHAN KRASSER: Writers/Directors; SIMON RIEDEL and JÖRN RÖVER: Executive Producers

programme.title: Animals at Play
programme.desc: Explore the ways that animals use play, including young gibbons in Thailand that practice falling from branches, elderly macaques that preserve their brains with playtime, and games that sharpen the profound intelligence of African elephants.

programme.title: Animals at Play
programme.desc: Young hyenas compete in tug of war, mischievous parrots play at picking apart tourists’ cars, and Atlantic spotted dolphins enjoy sophisticated social games amid seaweed—all following specific rules that hone social bonds.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School
programme.desc: Trouble brews when the team makes the final attempt to reunite reluctant mother Dilla with her new baby Delilah. And Alba, the world’s only known albino orangutan, amazes her friends with her unique approach to termite foraging.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: "There is nothing wrong with your television set." That famous line opens each episode of the classic science fiction anthology series as part of a narration that makes people think their TVs are being controlled. Episodes of the series, which numbered 49 over the course of two seasons, range from a mix of sci-fi and horror that feature "scary monster" motifs to episodes focused on the sci-fi aspects of the stories. Episode writers include such notables as series creator Leslie Stevens and Harlan Ellison.

programme.desc: Warning: do not watch Crave on an empty stomach. Because we’ll have you craving a creamy scoop of ice cream bedded on a crispy waffle. Our celebrities’ cravings know no bounds, and anything from local to Japanese to Mediterranean fare is fair game – as long as they crave it. And there’s a little special by Charlotte. On every show, she will cook a dish – guaranteed to make you crave for it.

As for his brother, Wesley (Nat Ho) , it signifies a life of freedom. Yet for Edrick’s best friend Jess (Felicia Chin), she simply blames her old-fashioned mother, who forced her to focus on her studies instead.\t\t.

programme.title: Crave
programme.desc: Warning: do not watch Crave on an empty stomach. Because we’ll have you craving a creamy scoop of ice cream bedded on a crispy waffle. Or really, really needing to crunch into juicy fried chicken right now. Hosted by Charlotte Mei, the runner-up of Eat List Star, Crave finds out what gets celebrities salivating – roti prata, roast meats, sushi, satay, salted egg ice cream, buah keluak, and even an English-style big breakfast! Our celebrities’ cravings know no bounds, and anything from local to Japanese to Mediterranean fare is fair game – as long as they crave it. And there’s a little special by Charlotte. On every show, she will cook a dish – guaranteed to make you crave for it.

programme.desc: A story about the creation and history of the planet, the laws governing it, its shape, the richness of flora and fauna, threats to the natural environment, natural wonders and surprising relationships.Actor Will Smith and people who have had the opportunity to spend time in space will talk about this extraordinary place in the universe.Accounts from astronauts including Mae Jemison, Mike Massimino, Leland Melvin and Chris Austin Hadfield will provide a completely new perspective on Earth.Director Darren Aronofsky and his film crew visited 45 countries and six continents.The photos were taken, among others, in the Arctic, the Himalayas, India and during the annual festival in Tarragona, Spain.Materials recorded on board the International Space Station were also used.In the following episodes, viewers will learn how oxygen is produced, the protective layers of the Blue Planet and the entire sequence of events that led to the creation of life.The topic of death, colonization, destruction, the search for alien forms and human intellect will also be discussed.

programme.title: Secrets of the Bees: Season 1
programme.desc: National Geographic traveler and explorer, Bertie Gregory, takes viewers on a fascinating journey into the world of bees.For three years, the creators of the documentary conducted observations, using specialized cameras placed inside the hive to capture the life of these insects up close.The film reveals their complex architecture, social behavior and extraordinary intelligence of over 20,000 species of bees.They are responsible for pollinating one third of the food produced in the world and are considered one of the most important animals on our planet. Director and explorer Bertie Gregory has been working with National Geographic for years.Traveling to the farthest corners of the world, he has already explored the secret lives of sharks, penguins and cheetahs.His latest film, produced by James Cameron, is exceptional.It talks about the world of insects that are right next to us.Although scientists are aware of their key role in the ecosystem, they still hide many secrets and can surprise.More and more advanced filming technology allows you to look at inconspicuous bees from a groundbreaking perspective - on a scale where even flowers look like skyscrapers.The world of small giants The creators of the documentary placed specialized cameras inside the hive to closely observe its inhabitants for three years.This allowed them to capture how insects communicate and use tools.They saw what happens when a hive is attacked.The second part of the document shows, among others:fight for survival before the coming winter.In different parts of the Earth, different species face their own challenges - some compete for mates by living in clay hideouts, others try to survive the attack of a parasite.Researchers are looking for ways to ensure the future of small giants.

programme.desc: A profile of a man who went down in history as a brilliant military strategist.The six-episode series will present little-known facts from the life of the fearless leader.The authors will show how, after a difficult childhood and captivity, he managed to gain power, unite the quarreling tribes, build an invincible army and subjugate all those who opposed him, including his former allies.Impressive conquests will be discussed, including:expansion into the West, campaigns against the neighboring Tangut people and the Chinese Jin Empire.The troops he commanded were known for the mobility of their cavalry, carrying out rapid attacks and retreats, and applying psychological pressure on their opponents.They used innovative techniques when besieging even well-fortified cities.Genghis Khan became one of the most important figures in history, expanding his empire to unprecedented sizes.It stretched from the Pacific to the Caspian and Black Seas.The creators of the series are based on a new translation of the anonymous chronicle "The Secret History of the Mongols", which is the oldest known written monument of the steppe peoples of Central Asia.

But their quest won't be easy, as soon they are being pursued by greedy air pirates, the military and secret government agents, who all seek the power Sheeta alone can control.

programme.desc: Mega City One is a vast, violent metropolis where felons rule the streets. One day, Dredd is partnered with Cassandra (Olivia Thirlby), a rookie with powerful psychic abilities. A report of a terrible crime sends Dredd and Cassandra to a dangerous area controlled by Ma-Ma (Lena Headey), a drug lord who will stop at nothing to protect her empire.

Mary takes a stand against the deadly drug, crack, when she discovers that a wealthy and generous new friend of Calvin and Brenda is selling the drug.

Lester wins a major contracting bid, which enables the Jenkins' to begin looking for their dream home, when Lester discovers that the backers of the construction job are involved in South African investments.
Plans made by Mary (Marla Gibbs) and Lester (Hal Williams) to celebrate their 20th wedding anniversary result in disharmony when quarrelling in-laws come to town on.

Guest star Pee Wee Herman plays himself in this special episode in which he, Mary (Marla Gibbs), Lester (Hal Williams) and Sandra (Jackée) are held captive in a toy store and must resort to more than pop guns and bows and arrows to set themselves free.

When Sandra (Jackée) cleans up her act and takes on a whole new identity for her visiting mother, special guest star Della Reese, she must split her personality to make another out-of-town guest, her "HUNK DU JOUR," happy as well.

When Sandra (Jackée) alerts the police that she suspects her current love interest Justin (Sam Scarber) has stolen more than her heart, the detectives set up surveillance headquarters in the home of Mary (Marla Gibbs) and Lester (Hal Williams).

Guest stars Red Buttons and Ron Glass appear in this unique "Special Episode" of "227" which was videotaped only 24 hours prior to airing, enabling the characters to discuss late-breaking news items. This almost-live topical episode, featuring Mary (Marla Gibbs) and Lester (Hal Williams) on their way to being audited by the IRS.

Brenda attempts to ensnare a boy's affection by inviting him to her Saturday night party, and following Sandra's sneaky suggestion, she tells him the party's on Friday night--but the scheme backfires when her parents go out for the evening, leaving her more alone than she planned.

Mary flies out to California to take a spin on the popular game show "Wheel of Fortune," but is shocked to discover a smug Sandra as her opponent--much to the dismay of hosts Pat Sajak and Vanna White.

Sandra's efforts to win the attention of a famous congressman (Robert Hooks) become muddled when Brenda's art teacher (Jayne Kennedy) catches his eye--yet in her pursuit she falls for another famous personality: Billy Dee Williams. Special guest appearances by Billy Dee Williams, Jayne Kennedy and Robert Hooks.

When Mary (Marla Gibbs) accepts the "glamorous" title of Chairwoman of the Church benefit variety show, she soon realizes it's really a dirty job and prays for a group like the "Temptations" to save the show.
A surprise visit by his Air Force dad prompts Calvin to bid farewell to the family in exchange for a new life abroad with his father.

In efforts to find Rose a permanent mate, Mary and Sandra resort to a video dating service that transforms Rose into a Tina Turner look-a-like which eventually leads to an embarrassing and hilarious outcome when she meets her match.

When Pearl (Helen Martin) is refused her social security check because the computer lists her as deceased, Mary (Marla Gibbs), Rose (Alaina Reed) and Sandra (Jackée), join in the battle against bureaucracy, only to land themselves in jail.
Sandra writes a steamy romance novel based on characters that are suspiciously similar to her friends at 227.
Mary's new job with a travel agency takes her out-of-town on business with her boss, leaving a jealous Lester at home. Special guest appearance by Garrett Morris.

programme.title: Unobvious places
programme.desc: Katarzyna Jaroszyńska odwiedza właścicieli domów, którzy mieszkają w okolicach pozbawionych sąsiadów. Wśród mieszkańców tego typu samotni jest Szymon, żyjący w górskiej, porośniętej paprociami okolicy. Jego betonowa oaza, wyposażona w duże, zapewniające piękne widoki okna, jest położona nad ziemią, powyżej linii gruntu. Inny uczestnik programu, oszczędny Kamil, mieszka w przestronnym budynku na wodzie. Jego lokum o powierzchni 200 m kw. to jeden z pierwszych polskich wodnych domów. Bartek, wielbiciel ciszy, spokoju i życia w trybie offline, żyje w samotni otoczonej lasem.

programme.title: Unobvious places
programme.desc: Tym razem prowadząca odwiedza właścicieli wiekowych domów z własną historią. Nowi gospodarze przeprowadzili renowację tych budynków i stworzyli sobie własne miejsca na ziemi tam, gdzie dawno temu żyły inne rodziny. Międzynarodowa para, Ania i Paul, pasjonują się archiwaliami i zabytkami. Żyją w liczącym dwa wieki domu tkacza, położonym w urokliwej krainie wygasłych wulkanów. Miłość Kasi i Mariusza do górskich okolic okazała się silniejsza od przywiązania do życia w stolicy. Postanowili więc na stałe zamieszkać w 80-letnim gospodarstwie na samym szczycie wzgórza Paproć. Natomiast Kasia i Darek żyją w wymarzonym, starym młynie w okolicach Kazimierza Dolnego. Zachowali jego historyczny rys, dodając wyłącznie niezbędne unowocześnienia.

programme.title: Unobvious places
programme.desc: Konrad decided to use second-hand elements to build his house, such as old doors and windows.In turn, the architect Magda is interested in ecological construction.The heroine will present her favorite project, i.e. the metamorphosis of an old barn into a residential house.Karolina and Janusz have always dreamed of having their own plot of land with a nice view.Finally, they managed to fulfill this wish by purchasing land in Dobczyce, Lesser Poland.Due to the fact that they used almost the entire budget to buy the land, they had to find a way to build the estate for only PLN 6,000.zlotys.

programme.title: Taste the world with Pascal
programme.desc: Pascal will visit Algeria - a culinary melting pot born from the combination of Berber, Bedouin and French cuisine.The journey begins in Algiers, where he learns about local delicacies and goes shopping at the oldest market in the capital.Use them to make an eggplant and meat apple pie.In the evening, in a confectionery shop with sweets, he learns what their secret is.Pascal's next stop is Bou Sada.The cook, together with Rashid and his family, prepares a traditional snack - sveti.Then he goes to the largest dromedary farm to learn the secret of camel milk.

programme.title: Taste the world with Pascal
programme.desc: Pascal continues his journey through Algeria.In Tipaza he goes out to sea to collect nets.Then, grilled fish with vegetable sauce is prepared on the shore in the company of a crowd of passers-by.Then Pascal finds the oldest shop selling dates and finds out why they are so popular.The cook is invited to a spontaneous party with local decision-makers and journalists.Unfortunately, the next day Pascal has an accident, tears his ankle ligament and damages the joint capsule.However, he does not give up and returns to cooking the next day.Pea soup with spices is made in a palm grove.And for dessert, thousand-hole pancakes with date jam.

programme.title: Taste the world with Pascal
programme.desc: Cameras visit the clove plantations for which Zanzibar is famous.Viewers will discover how they are grown, harvested and dried, as well as how the best spices are selected.The cook Habiba will reveal the secrets of traditional dishes of this country, and at the same time Pascal will find out what the women of Zanzibar think about men who get involved in cooking.A healer from a friendly village will tell the host about the healing properties of cloves.Finally, Pascal will show you how to combine colorful African cuisine with Polish flavors and prepare a simple chicken curry in coconut milk.He will also explain why he loves one-pot meals.

programme.title: Taste the world with Pascal
programme.desc: This time Pascal will visit a cinnamon plantation.He will be guided through the cultivation by Said, a multi-talented man who can boast of knowing five languages, including Polish.It turns out that cinnamon is dried tree bark.The chef will learn about the healing properties of this plant and the history of the entire island.Ali, Said's father and the village headman, will talk about the beginnings of cinnamon cultivation in Zanzibar and their impact on the functioning of the local community.In addition, Pascal will learn how local houses are built and will try his hand at being a bricklayer.Additionally in the episode: secrets of producing coconut oil and milk from fresh coconuts;schools that were created thanks to crops;making unusual soap and visiting the local market, where you can try traditional wheat pancakes with cinnamon.Pascal himself will prepare pancakes with pineapple, vanilla, coconut flakes and - of course - the flagship spice of Zanzibar.

programme.title: Man, Woman, Wild
programme.desc: In the program, a married couple takes up the challenge and tries to survive in the wilderness.Mykel Hawke is an expert in the US Army Special Forces Survival School, and his wife Ruth is a television journalist.We will meet them in the most remote and dangerous corners of the world, where they will have to survive for four days with only a knife.This is one of the most difficult exams that will test not only their resilience, but also the durability of their marriage in extreme situations.Mykel was taught how to survive in any conditions.However, for Ruth, encounters with wildlife are a completely new experience.A man will have to teach his wife how to build a roof over her head and how to look for food.

programme.title: Candid about Love
programme.desc: Laura, a gallery assistant and wannabe fine art photographer, is finally promised a spot in a Newcomer’s Showcase - but only if she can get a reclusive artist, Shane, to premiere his newest photographs at the gallery. When Laura discovers that Shane hasn’t taken a new photo in ten years, she’s determined to help him find his way back to his art whether he wants her to or not.

programme.title: A Snapshot of Forever
programme.desc: Wedding photographer Jessie Brooke's cozy small-town life takes an unexpected turn when a well-known Hollywood actor arrives at her family's lakeside vineyard for his sister's wedding.

programme.title: The Snows of Kilimanjaro
programme.desc: Writer Harry Street reflects on his life as he lies dying from an infection while on safari in the shadow of Mount Kilamanjaro.

programme.title: Eruption: LA
programme.desc: As the earth crumbles under the feet of the unsuspecting Angelenos, and a sea of hot lava is about to boil over, a geology geek and a young disaster-movie diva must avert a nightmare come true. Will the mayor act fast before it's too late?

programme.title: Lassie Come Home
programme.desc: Remake of the 1943 movie based on Eric Knight's book Lassie Come Home.

programme.title: Dying for a Baby
programme.desc: Amber and Kyle are ready to move on after a car accident two years ago. But their world turns upside down when Jessica, the other driver who lost her unborn baby in the accident, moves in next door and gets a job with Amber’s doctor - all in a plan to seek a cold form of revenge.

programme.title: Killer in Red
programme.desc: Christa Bright is an aspiring personal stylist who has an instant connection with new client Kat Niven, a shy woman who needs help gaining confidence. But Kat's admiration for Christa turns into an all consuming obsession with Christa and her fiancé, and she will stop at nothing to get what she wants. A.K.A My Killer Client

programme.title: The Secret Laughter of Women
programme.desc: A beautiful young single mother feels the pressure from the ex-pat Nigerian community to get married. Her precocious son has met his hero, a cynical English comic book writer and decides he is a match for his mum. The fall for each other but their love is tested by resistance from the community.

programme.title: Love & Other Drugs
programme.desc: In 1990s Pittsburgh, a medicine peddler starts a relationship with a young woman suffering from Parkinson's disease.

programme.title: Attack of the Lederhosen Zombies
programme.desc: Zombie action in the Alps: a group of young snowboarder is stuck in a remote mountain ski resort, where an all-night aprés-ski party soon turns into a hellish nightmare of zombie mayhem.

programme.title: Death Trench
programme.desc: In the final days of WWI, an allied army unit led by a shell-shocked soldier is sent to investigate a mysterious abandoned German facility located deep underground. What they find is fate worse than death. A.K.A. Trench 11

programme.title: Dangerous Mind of a Hooligan
programme.desc: Five criminals unknown to each other are hired to complete a bank robbery. What should have been a smooth operation soon descends into paranoia, violence and horror.

programme.title: Bridal Boot Camp
programme.desc: Andy Phillips is preparing for her upcoming wedding with her fiancé, Jordan. However, after chatting with her best friend, Andy starts to question if she has what it takes to make a strong and lasting marriage.

programme.title: Back to Love
programme.desc: A young widow returns home for the first time in three years to help prepare her sister's wedding. She is forced to confront her past, including the man she never expected to fall for.

programme.title: Coffee Shop
programme.desc: When a young coffee shop owner is threatened with repossession she must take a chance with life and love as she fights to save her business.

programme.title: Royal Wedding
programme.desc: A brother and sister dance duo face hurdles and find love when they’re set to perform in London for the Royal Wedding.
